 All Highlights Fours Sixes Wicket UDRS 35.6 Rizwanullah to Yashveer Goud, no run, short of length delivery wide of off, Yashveer reaches out to cut and misses 35.5 Rizwanullah to Kavya Patel, 1 run, full delivery outside off stump, Kavya leans forward and drives uppishly to deep cover 35.4 Rizwanullah to Kavya Patel, no run, covers the line and defends 35.4 Rizwanullah to Kavya Patel, wide , fired down the leg-side 35.3 Rizwanullah to Kavya Patel, no run, short of length delivery wide of off, Kavya plays and misses as he tries to guide it square on the off-side 35.2 W Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, out Caught by Farhan Yousaf!! This is high and it's a good running catch from mid-on. Pakistan are so relieved so see the back of Arjun Rajput. He's been a thorn in their flesh. Wherever you are, whoever you support, take a moment to stand and applaud this young kid. That's exactly what the crowd and the Indian dugout is doing. Rizwanullah seemed to taken pace off for this shortish ball and sucked Arjun into the pull shot early. Arjun wanted to clear the infield off the back foot again, skied that so high off the bottom of the bat. Mid-on ran in and took is near the bowler's stumps. Arjun drags himself off dejected but he's put on a bold show that made the world salute. The lone warrior walks off! Arjun Rajput c Farhan Yousaf b Rizwanullah 107(85) [4s-11 6s-5] 35.2 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, wide , short delivery, Arjun sways out. Too high for me says Arjun 35.1 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, shortish delivery, Arjun mistimes the pull to the on-side 33.6 Rizwanullah to Yashveer Goud, 1 run, just gets his bat down in time to meet this length delivery and save those stumps, played past backward point 33.5 Rizwanullah to Yashveer Goud, no run, driven to cover 33.4 Rizwanullah to Yashveer Goud, no run, plays inside the line and misses again! Short of a length delivery, Yashveer pokes at it and misses 33.3 Rizwanullah to Yashveer Goud, no run, beaten! Full delivery outside off stump, Yashveer looks to drive and misses 33.2 Rizwanullah to Yashveer Goud, no run, full delivery, Yashveer drove it to mid-on 33.1 Rizwanullah to Yashveer Goud, no run, good length delivery, Yashveer pushes it to the off-side 33.1 Rizwanullah to Yashveer Goud, wide , fired down the leg-side 31.6 W Rizwanullah to Manal Chauhan, out Bowled!! Through him and that fighting 64-run stand ends. Why did it end? Again because of indecisiveness. Manal wasn't properly forward to defend, didn't cover the line either. Just hung his bat out in hope and ended up dragging it onto his own stumps. Just as Arjun was getting some help from his partner finally, Manal throws it away. Manal Chauhan b Rizwanullah 11(19) [4s-1] 31.5 Rizwanullah to Manal Chauhan, no run, fullish and on the off stump, Manal defends from the crease 31.4 4 Rizwanullah to Manal Chauhan, FOUR , nicely done! Short delivery angling in at the head, Manal leans back and guides it fine past the keeper for one bounce four 31.3 Rizwanullah to Manal Chauhan, no run, full delivery on the off stump, Manal guides to point 31.2 Rizwanullah to Manal Chauhan, no run, short of length delivery, Manal looks to defend, gets an inside edge onto pad 31.1 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, short of length delivery around the off stump, punched off the back foot to deep point 17.6 4 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, FOUR , now Arjun Rajput gets lucky. Full on off, angled in, Rajput with a wild hoick to leg with no feet. He gets lucky as the thick inside edge runs away wide of the stumps to the fine-leg fence 17.5 4 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, FOUR , Arjun Rajput breaks the shackles with a good boundary. Full just outside off, Rajput gets forward and thumps it to the right of Rizwanullah. Was in the air, but sped away 17.4 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, beaten! Full and shapes back into fifth-stump line, then it moves away late to beat the leaden-footed drive of Arjun Rajput. Remember Rizwanullah is bowling from round the wicket 17.3 Rizwanullah to Anvay Dravid, 1 run, back of a length outside off, Anvay Dravid goes on the back foot and mistimes the cut through the vacant point area 17.2 Rizwanullah to Anvay Dravid, no run, full outside off, channel bowling, Anvay Dravid gets forward and shoulders arms 17.1 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, full and wide outside off, Arjun Rajput reaches for it to drive, off the toe-end of the bat and third man is very fine 15.6 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, nearly sneaked through! On a short of length and nips back in to middle, Arjun Rajput is late on the back foot block, the thick inside edge could've gone anywhere, just misses leg-stump 15.5 Rizwanullah to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, short of length on the body, Aaryavir Sehwag again is hurried for pace, goes on the back foot to help it down and he gloves it behind square on the leg-side. Some words between the batter and the bowler, Sehwag shakes his head 15.4 Rizwanullah to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, that's a fine delivery. Rizwanullah follows-through and has a stare at Aaryavir Sehwag. It's a rising short of length delivery outside off, Sehwag walks and looks to punch, it gets big on him and he is lucky not to outside edge that 15.3 Rizwanullah to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, short on leg-stump, Aaryavir Sehwag ducks 15.2 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, short of length on the body, Arjun Rajput goes on the back foot and pulls to fine-leg. Went fine and the fielder was fine as well 15.1 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, beautiful delivery. Angle in from round the wicket to fifth-stump line, then leaves the left-hander, who pokes and misses 13.6 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, oh yeah, there's the bumper as expected. Fast bowlers don't miss these cues. Arjun this time sits easily under it though 13.5 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, oh he's given signs of not playing the short ball well and the Pakistanis will take note. Short delivery, Arjun was late on the shot and he spliced this to mid-on. Arjun Rajput has looked solid otherwise 13.4 Rizwanullah to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, oh taps it wide of mid-on and sets off on a risky run. A direct-hit would have been curtains 13.3 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, fullish delivery on the leg stump, Arjun clips it to deep square leg 13.2 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, again nicely gets behind the line and defends with soft hands to cover-point, thinks of a quick single and kills that idea himself 13.1 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, fullish delivery on the off stump, Arjun gets right behing the line and defends 11.6 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, beaten . Short of a length delivery, plays inside the line and misses 11.5 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, fullish delivery outside off stump, left alone 11.4 W Rizwanullah to Yashbardhan Chauhan, out Bowled!! Through the gate and timbahhh. Yashbardhan Chauhan didn't look convincing at all in his recent balls. Wonder why so much indecisiveness and it has curbed him, forcing false shots. Oh hang on, is he going to escape with a no ball? The umps are checking if the bowler has anything behind the line. It's not clear enough. When it finishes it's definitely over the line but what matters if the first point of impact of the heel. The visuals are blurred and the third ump has to deal with it. He's asked for zoomer and even then it's not clear. And he's given the benefit of doubt to the bowler. There is no way the third ump can conclusively say that's behind the line or on the line with that shaky visual. They had a problem displaying the decision on the big screen so the onfield ump is informed it it out. Now OUT flashes on the screen. But Yashbardhan was completely surprised by the ball nipping back in from good length and he left the gate open for it to sneak through and hit top of off. This outing probably will be a good lesson for him to commit fully to his shots. The feet weren't there even when he tried to defend this ball that created a massive gap. Yashbardhan Chauhan b Rizwanullah 1(11) 11.3 Rizwanullah to Yashbardhan Chauhan, no run, again doesn't make contact ! Again not fully committing to the cut shot, so Yashbardhan misses. Throws his head back in disappointment 11.2 Rizwanullah to Yashbardhan Chauhan, no run, beaten now !
